-Wonderfully Presented 3 Bedroom Semi Detached Family Home

- Light & Bright With Excellent Specification

-Only A Short Distance From Shankill Village

-A Mature Residential Enclave With Extensive Green Space Amenities

-Large Rear Garden With Elevated Sun Terrace

Premium Collection are delighted to present this wonderful 3 Bedroom semi-detached family home nestled within the highly sought after mature residential enclave of Crinken Glen. Overlooking an expansive amenity green to the front and only a short distance from Shankill Village this warm and spacious home is impeccably presented with a high standard of specification and finish.

Upon entering this home, you immediately get a sense of spaciousness and top quality specification and finish. Downstairs comprises a good sized living room with an open Corian feature fireplace and large front windows looking out at the mature front garden. Double French doors open from this space into a bright and spacious contemporary kitchen/dining room featuring limestone flooring, eye-catching black high gloss cabinetry with butcher block countertops and quality integrated appliances. 

Upstairs comprises three good sized bedrooms with fitted wardrobes and a main bathroom off the central landing, which features a bath/shower and floor to ceiling tile. The attic is floored and provides excellent storage.

The whole downstairs area features glass-paneled doors that allow light to fill every space and there are two large patio doors opening onto a spacious two-tiered mature back garden, which includes a large garden shed that is plumbed and powered, offering excellent extra storage. The elevated sun deck, surrounded by lush raised bedding, is ideal for entertaining and barbecues and provides a perfect space for relaxation.

The mature front garden of this home looks out over an expansive green space amenity and provides ample parking with scope for more if needed. 

Offering an excellent location being only a short distance from Shankill Village, this home is convenient to almost every amenity with local shops, retail outlets, restaurants, coffee shops and a variety of recreational and sporting facilities nearby. Situated close to both the mountains and the sea, with superb transport links including M11/N11, M50, multiple bus routes, DART and Aircoach, there are numerous school options easily accessible from this residence and for those that like the outdoors, there is an abundance of choice.

Viewing is highly recommended.
